name: DIMFE call for projects

funder.name: Donors' Initiative for Mediterranean Freshwater Ecosystems (DIMFE)

administered_by.name: Prince Albert II of Monaco Foundation

summary: Annual call funding EUR 100,000 to 500,000 for field-based conservation and restoration of Mediterranean freshwater ecosystems, open to NGOs, local authorities and others; research-only projects are excluded. Above EUR 300,000, 25% cash co-financing is mandatory.

status.quote: The completed application form and both correctly filled-in budget tables must be submitted by October 15, 2026

deadline.quote: The completed application form and both correctly filled-in budget tables must be submitted by October 15, 2026

administered_by.quote: Fondation Prince Albert II de Monaco (coordinator of the Donors' Initiative for Mediterranean Freshwater Ecosystems)

applicant_types.quote: NGOs, local authorities, municipalities, private companies engaged in the ecological transition with less than 20 employees, scientific institutions.

geography.quote: Projects must be located within the Mediterranean basin, without geographical preference.

access.quote: must be submitted by October 15, 2026 to the following email address: dimfe@fpa2.org

window.quote: The completed application form and both correctly filled-in budget tables must be submitted by October 15, 2026

co_finance_required.quote: If the request for funding exceeds €300,000, 25% co-financing (non-in-kind) is mandatory.
